title: Community Engagement Manager, Data Centers (Indiana & Kentucky)
description:
About Anthropic
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role
 Anthropic is building AI systems that will shape the trajectory of one of the most consequential technologies in human history. That work requires physical infrastructure at significant scale, and building that infrastructure the right way means being a real, long-term partner to the communities where we operate.
 We are looking for a Community Engagement Manager in Indiana and Kentucky to join our Public Policy team and serve as Anthropic's on-the-ground presence in the communities where our data centers are sited, built, and operated. This is not a communications role or a government affairs role, though you will do elements of both. It is a relationship role: your job is to make Anthropic a trusted, visible, and valued neighbor, from the earliest stages of site selection through construction and long-term operations.
 You will be the connective tissue between Anthropic's Policy and Infrastructure teams and the local officials, community organizations, economic development partners, and residents who have a stake in what we build. You will surface concerns before they escalate, translate our technical and operational plans into clear local benefits, and build the coalitions that allow us to move quickly and responsibly. Because Anthropic's infrastructure footprint is still early in its growth, you will also help write the playbook: the processes you build in your first markets are the ones we will use as we expand.
 You will travel regularly within Indiana and Kentucky, up to 50% of the time, and occasionally to other Anthropic data center markets.

title: Business Development Partner
description:
Business Development Partner (Commission-Based)
 ProcJet Ltd | United Kingdom | Remote | Flexible
 Contract: Self-Employed / Independent Contractor
 Remuneration: Commission Only, No Fixed Salary
 About ProcJet ProcJet Ltd is a UK-based industrial procurement and supply chain company supporting the energy, oil & gas, utilities, EPC and infrastructure sectors.
 We specialise in UK and European equipment sourcing, industrial materials, OEM and obsolete spare parts, specialist equipment supply and project procurement support.
 We are seeking an experienced Business Development Partner to help expand our UK customer base and generate new commercial opportunities.
 The Opportunity We are looking for a commercially driven professional who can use their existing industry network to introduce ProcJet to potential customers and help convert genuine opportunities into business.
 Your responsibilities will include:
 Identifying new customers and procurement opportunities within UK industrial and energy sectors.
 Leveraging existing relationships with operators, EPC contractors, engineering companies and procurement teams.
 Introducing ProcJet to key decision-makers and arranging client meetings.
 Identifying live RFQs, equipment requirements and project opportunities.
 Supporting commercial discussions and converting enquiries into orders.
 Developing long-term customer relationships and repeat business.
 Who We Are Looking For Proven business development or commercial experience in energy, oil & gas, utilities, EPC or industrial supply.
 An established UK industry network with access to relevant decision-makers.
 Demonstrated ability to generate genuine business opportunities.
 Good understanding of industrial procurement and equipment supply.
 Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
 Self-motivated, commercially focused and able to work independently.

title: Principal Implementation Engineer, Customer Support
description:
Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com. 

Bitwarden truly cares and wants all Bitwarden users to have the best experience while accessing their sensitive information. The Customer Success team helps customers and all users meaningfully engage with Bitwarden products while proactively planning for user growth, service availability, and to ultimately achieve their desired outcome. Team members have excellent product knowledge, superb technical skills, stellar grammar, attention to detail, and the ability to explain complicated things simply.

Bitwarden seeks a server and cloud enthusiast, with experience in both communicating about and deploying these technologies. You will become a Bitwarden product expert and partner with the Customer Engagement Managers to help customers with their initial production deployments post-sales, as well as implement new features as they are released and increase their adoption of the Bitwarden platform.

This is an all-remote team and we’re looking for someone located in the UK.
